title: AcquisitionDescriptor
description: The versioned acquisition seam (design note §4): a stable JSON descriptor an acquisition front-end (OpenShelf, a museum API, the DosCo, a local FS scan) EMITS and s3Dgraphy CONSUMES. The canonical schema lives here in JSON_config; emitters depend only on the published schema, never on s3Dgraphy internals. Tier 0 (opaque source) = payload_graph ABSENT (no inherited genesis/interpretation). schema_version is the contract version.

schema_version.description: Contract version. This schema is v0; the major must match the consumer's SCHEMA_VERSION.

asset.description: The digital object being acquired. Exactly one locator (bytes_ref | url | local_path) identifies it; the resource layer (R0–R2) resolves it.

ref.description: Locator: a local path, a file://, s3:// or http(s) URL. (Generic single-field form of bytes_ref|url|local_path.)

name.description: Optional human label for the asset (e.g. the source record title).

source.description: The catalog/repo the asset came from + its capability flags.

capabilities.description: What the source can provide beyond flat metadata. Tier 0 = [] (opaque).

rights.description: Literal-first rights (design §7): license + optional holder/url captured as provenance literals; ODRL/HDTO formalization deferred.

acquisition.description: The acquisition event itself (retrieval): when, by which tool, how. Modelled as a distinct DTC event (crmdig:D12_Data_Transfer_Event).

method.description: Acquisition method — maps to the DTC 'acquisition' kind (download / ingest / local_import) when recognized.

attribution.description: Present when the payload carries interpretation (Tier 2): who asserts the imported study. Absent in Tier 0.

payload_graph.description: Inherited sub-graph (Tier 1 genesis / Tier 2 interpretation). ABSENT in Tier 0. Node-type-agnostic; scope declares what it carries. Consumed by a later session — not by the Tier-0 hook.

ref_url.description: Lazy reference to the source graph — reference.

resources.description: Transitive resources referenced by the payload.
